senses.gloss:
क्व क्व, i. e. क + व (cf. इ + व), from किम्, adv.
 1. = loc. sing. of किम्. In whom, Man. 10, 66.
 2. Where, Rām. 5, 34, 21.
 3. Whither, Pañc. 36, 21.
 4. क्व--क्व denotes the greatest difference: क्व वयं क्व परोक्षमन्मथो मृगशावैः समम् एधितो जनः, What communion could there be between me and a girl grown up among young fawns and disinclined to love? Śāk. d. 51.
 5. How much less, Rām. 1, 67, 10.
 6. With following अपि, Somewhere, Hit. pr. d. 17; Pañc. 96, 5; with न, Nowhere, Nal. 16, 6.
 7. With न--च, Not anywhere, Bhāg. P. 4, 29, 64.
 8. With न--च न, Nowhere, MBh. 14, 650.
 9. With following चिद्,
 a. In some, [] Pañc. 118, 14.
 b. Somewhere, Lass. 6, 17; Kathās. 4, 131;
 c. With न, or another negative particle, Nowhere, Man. 2, 56; Rām. 3, 60, 5.
 d. क्व चिद्--क्व चिद्, Here and there, Rām. 2, 100, 6; क्व चिद्--क्व चिद्, Here--there, Kathās. 6, 26; 27; now--now, Rām. 3, 50, 7; with न, Never, Man. 2, 180.
 e. Some time, Nal. 14, 6.
 10. With preceding यत्र,
 a. and following अपि, or च, or वा, Wherever, Bhartṛ. 3, 91; Bhāg. P. 8, 12, 34; 1, 17, 36;
 b. and following च न, Wherever, Brāhmaṇ. 3, 12; whenever, Bhāg. P. 5, 21, 9.

क्वण् क्वण्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To sound, Ṛt. 3, 26.
 2. To buzz, Vikr. d. 103.
 क्वणित, n. Sound, Ragh. 7, 83.
 --Caus. To cause to sound, Bhāg. P. 3, 15, 21.

क्वथ् क्वथ्, i. 1, Par. To boil, Man. 6, 20.
 --Caus. क्वाथय, The same, Mārk. P. 12, 26.
 --With उद् उद्, To boil out, Suśr. 2, 418, 10.
 --Caus. The same, 2, 432, 15.
 --With निस् निस्, Caus. To boil down, Suśr. 2, 80, 16.
 --Cf. perhaps κότος, etc.
क्वथन क्वथ् + अन, n. Boiling, Suśr. 1, 171, 5.
क्वाथ क्वाथ, i. e. क्वथ् + अ, m. A decoction, Suśr. 2, 85, 10.
क्व- + निवास क्व- + निवास, adj. where dwelling, MBh. 1, 7114.
